content:
I finally completed the definition of Sandwiched Relative Renyi entropy -- it returns an ENNReal, which meant proving that the quantity was nonnegative. And that in turn required a lot of math. :)

  • Cauchy-Binet theorem
  • Definition and basic properties of singular values
  • Compound matrices, exterior powers
  • Majorization theory
  • Schatten (quasi-)norms of matrices
    ... which was then used to prove Holder's inequality for Schatten quasi norms. (We needed the case where p < 1 as well)

Aristotle pretty much did this autonomously: I just repeatedly fed the work so far and told it to work on proving it. When it had two or more sorries left (that were clearly not related to each other), I ran a separate run on each letting it "fork". I primarily just did the minimal cleanup needed to keep heartbeat counts reasonable and to remove linter warnings / messages.
